stages.title: Environment bootstrap
stages.description: Imports, constants, reproducibility helpers, and runtime information.

stages.title: Dataset setup
stages.description: Google Drive connection, archive verification, extraction, and split checks.

stages.title: Upstream source patching
stages.description: Dependency setup, pinned CLAMEA checkout, and source patches.

stages.title: GPU smoke test
stages.description: Model construction, backward pass, and exact-ranking oracle checks.

stages.title: Preflight report
stages.description: Technical preflight report creation and Drive upload.

stages.title: Training runner generation
stages.description: Builds the standalone training runner used by later stages.

stages.title: Training execution
stages.description: Locked/resumable baseline training orchestration.

stages.title: Pseudo-label audit
stages.description: Audits pseudo-label quality without training or test-label selection.

stages.title: Evaluation stability
stages.description: Checks checkpoint and repeated-evaluation stability.

stages.title: Training reproducibility
stages.description: Runs the short reproducibility diagnostic.

stages.title: Deterministic training
stages.description: Isolates and tests deterministic negative sampling.

stages.title: Controlled self-training
stages.description: Runs controlled deterministic self-training diagnostics.

stages.title: Root-cause isolation
stages.description: Separates candidate causes of reproducibility differences.

stages.title: Graph augmentation diagnosis
stages.description: Diagnoses graph augmentation behavior in an isolated workspace.

stages.title: Final reproduction preflight
stages.description: Freezes and verifies the final reproduction protocol.

stages.title: Dependency check
stages.description: Checks FAISS and imports the patched CLAMEA source.

stages.title: Stage 5 training
stages.description: Runs one frozen Stage 5 training job per invocation.

stages.title: Run integrity audit
stages.description: Audits the nine completed runs without training or test evaluation.

stages.title: Final test evaluation
stages.description: Evaluates nine frozen validation-selected checkpoints on Test.

stages.title: Final reproduction analysis
stages.description: Builds aggregate tables, plots, and narrative from frozen artifacts.

stages.title: W&B history upload
stages.description: Publishes existing frozen historical results to W&B.

stages.title: W&B report table
stages.description: Safely inserts the rendered results table into an existing report.

stages.title: W&B report evidence
stages.description: Adds complete nine-run evidence to the existing report.
